hypothesis: The weak conventional Bayesian in C29 used source-selected action, direction and current front but discarded goal-relative coordinates and distance; this made lower native Brier unfit for native architectural superiority. Equal native 9-feature source-public right and 3-action, ~54 weight+momentum conventional model is required.

models.native: Unmodified additive C29 action-specific fast/slow original Ygg R1 local-cell offspring
models.conventional_online_sgd: Independent complete 9-feature exact public embedding and three 9-weight action-specific conventional online logistic matrices, learning-rate 0.16 and regularization 0.0, no momentum; no original R1 cell learn method.
models.conventional_online_momentum: Same independent 9-feature 3-action logistic, independent 9-per-action momentum vector 0.85, learning-rate 0.16, coefficients and momentum clipped to [-32,32]; exactly 54 scalar effective parameters as native fast/slow cells.
models.prior_temporal_bayes: Original unchanged C29 lower-feature independent temporal Beta; historical comparison only.
models.time_only: Original unchanged C29 no-selected-action Beta control.
models.frozen: Original unchanged C29 no-learning native prior
models.shuffled: Original unchanged C29 shifted-selected-action-training native cells

data_policy: Use exact unchanged C29 8-of-12 per-family FIT train / 4-of-12 per-family internal FIT check; no new source episodes. Never tune learning rates/regularization/feature aggregation on check/DEV, and do not combine two C28 source-repeat copies.
reporting: Brier and logloss all arms on identical internal 341 FIT events before further training
Per original-source family and chosen-action counts/Brier to flag imbalance
Prediction/action-decision differences and fixed proxy outcomes are source-free, NOT real-world causal-value decisions
CPU and full checkpoint bytes with fresh OS process prediction and proxy parity
Full nine-dimensional feature parity verified against exact original R1 on public input examples
Classify any native advantage/equality/defeat versus best feature-matched conventional honestly; do not assert significance from correlated FIT steps.
hard_stop: No original MiniGrid environment import/reset/step, no new training cohort outside C28, no DEV/VALID/holdouts, no protected first-use while FSA #83 OPEN, no original owner R1/R2/R3 modifications, no acceptance/main promotion or full G29 claim.
